review.review_scope: RAG-013 source-mapped quote follow-up cards listed in the RAG-014 case file.

accepted_quote_clearance_items.project_rule: When a customer names a problem, reflect one short neutral phrase back as a clarification question before moving deeper.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.safe_application: Use once to verify the problem in the customer's words and invite elaboration only if they want to explain.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.do_not_use_when: Do not parrot the customer, use repetitive mirroring, or keep probing after a short answer, correction, or refusal.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.guardrail_notes: Reflection must clarify, not extract disclosure. The customer can correct the phrase or decline to expand.

accepted_quote_clearance_items.project_rule: After a customer voluntarily agrees to a meeting or callback, confirm the date, time, channel, and expected next step in one concise check.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.safe_application: Use only after explicit agreement, and optionally ask whether a reminder or calendar invite is helpful.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.do_not_use_when: Do not stack confirmations before consent, imply commitment that was not given, or maximize attendance through pressure.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.guardrail_notes: Confirmation protects clarity and consent; it cannot become a compliance workaround or pressure loop.

accepted_quote_clearance_items.source_title: Behavioral Science Concepts - BehavioralEconomics.com | The BE Hub
accepted_quote_clearance_items.project_rule: When a customer has confirmed a problem and prefers to wait, ask neutrally whether keeping the current path has a cost worth considering.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.safe_application: Use as one cost-of-inaction check tied only to customer-confirmed facts and campaign-approved impacts.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.do_not_use_when: Do not invent hidden costs, fear-monger, shame indecision, or use this when the customer sounds anxious or overwhelmed.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.guardrail_notes: The agent may surface tradeoffs, but the customer owns the timing and can choose no next step.

accepted_quote_clearance_items.source_title: Behavioral Science Concepts - BehavioralEconomics.com | The BE Hub
accepted_quote_clearance_items.project_rule: Validate the customer's prior effort before comparing future tradeoffs.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.safe_application: Use when a customer has invested time, money, work, or reputation into a current tool, provider, or process.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.do_not_use_when: Do not call their valuation irrational, dismiss the current setup, attack past decisions, or force a pivot.
accepted_quote_clearance_items.guardrail_notes: After validation, compare only campaign-approved ROI, effort, risk, and fit tradeoffs.

rejected_followup_items.rejection_reason: Fixed rep talk-time dominance optimizes control over listening and does not fit a low-pressure, vertical-agnostic sales-agent core.
rejected_followup_items.replacement_guidance: Favor customer-led listening, concise answers, and campaign-stage-specific discovery instead of a fixed agent talk-time target.
